tasks.subject: Task 2: Strict lineage-required commit gate
tasks.description:
Worker: _partition_entities_by_lineage(merged) runs in derive_ontology_graph_merge right after merge_and_resolve, BEFORE _build_provenance_envelope — filters merged.entities to lineage-complete (element_uid+page), prunes merged.edges referencing rejected identities (so domain/structural/audit paths never see rejects), records a hard run-level rejection signal. Strict, never silent. tests/unit/test_lineage_commit_gate.py.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/workers/pipeline.py", "tests/unit/test_lineage_commit_gate.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_lineage_commit_gate.py -v"}
```

tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 5: End-to-end lineage verification gate
tasks.description:
Prove on a fresh SA-2 graph_only run: entity vertices>0 consistent with merged count; zero provenance-drop + zero spurious gate rejects; EXTRACTED_FROM/MENTIONED_IN>0; one field value traced to chunk+document+page; empty-doc (cw_radar.jpg) yields 0 legitimately. scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py. USER-ORDERED GATE.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py --run <fixed_sa2_run_id>", "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "requireEvidenceTokens": [["entities-committed", "vertices>0"], ["field-traced", "page"]]}
```
